text: Welcome to the Heal India Global hospital portal. Let's follow Sanjeevani Heart Institute as it cares for international patients, from the first enquiry to payout.
Hospital teams sign in on the main website, through the same secure door as patients and agents.
The dashboard opens with quick links to open enquiries and upcoming admissions.
Live counters track enquiries, quotes, admissions, patients in treatment and this month's revenue, with monthly charts below.
Recent enquiries sit at the bottom, so nothing new slips through.
Enquiries and cases lists every request sent to the hospital, with status tabs across the top.
Tabs, urgency, dates and search narrow the list. Here, only new enquiries still waiting for a reply.
Let's open Hamed Al-Rawahi's enquiry from Oman about heart valve replacement.
The case shows the patient, the requested doctor and his message, then the AI screening summary: symptoms, impact, budget, languages and suggested procedures.
Report readings are findings the AI extracted from his echocardiogram and the patient confirmed. Urgent findings and abnormal labs stand out, and patient edits are marked.
The original documents are right below, ready to download and verify.
Decline closes an enquiry with a reason for the patient. We'll cancel, because we can help him.
Instead, we build an itemised quote, starting from the usual cost lines.
We describe the treatment plan and the expected stay. Quotes are valid for thirty days by default.
Then we price each line and add the valve implant. The total updates as we type.
One click sends it. The patient is notified at once, and the case moves to quoted.
Bookings lists every admission, with tabs from pending payment to discharged.
Search finds a patient instantly.
The calendar view shows admissions by month, so the ward can plan beds ahead.
A booking shows the treatment, doctor, admission date and payment status, including the deposit held in escrow.
Admit patient records the arrival; we'll just peek at the dialog and cancel. Once a patient is admitted, Discharge and complete appears here.
The itinerary plans appointments, admission and follow-ups, and items can be added at any time.
The hospital uploads its e-Medical visa invitation letter right here, next to transfers like the airport pickup.
A completed booking keeps the full record, from admission to discharge.
Doctors lists your specialists with experience, rating, fee and medical registration; the check mark means the registration is verified.
The doctor form holds specialty, qualifications, languages and registration. We'll close it unchanged.
Each doctor has an availability calendar for teleconsults and admissions.
Procedures and pricing is your price list, with price ranges, stay and success rates.
Each procedure has bookable packages, showing exactly what is included.
The hospital profile holds contact details, accreditations, specialties, KYC documents and the payout account.
Accreditations, languages and the international desk are shown to patients.
KYC documents like registration, PAN and GST certificates are uploaded here for verification.
Team shows everyone with portal access, and their role.
Invite member sends a secure invitation with a chosen role. We'll cancel this one.
Reviews collects patient feedback; published reviews appear on your public profile.
Finance shows what is pending, eligible, on hold and paid out, and each settlement item after platform commission.
Payouts tracks bank transfers to the hospital.
Statements give opening and closing balances, earnings and every ledger entry for a period.
And here is the payout bank account.
Messages keeps one secure conversation per case. Let's reply to Mister Al-Rawahi.
Notifications collects every alert, with a filter for unread ones.
The top bar shows the active hospital; owners of several hospitals get a switcher here.
The sidebar collapses to icons, and expands again with one click.
And dark mode is a single toggle away.
That's the hospital portal: enquiries, quotes, admissions, doctors, pricing and payouts, all in one place. Thank you for watching.
